name: Carousel spin (your reels spin round you)
what: Your reels stand in a 3D carousel round you, each turned to face outward, near ones big and bright, far ones small and dim behind your head. It opens out, spins fast, slows to a stop with reel 1 facing the camera, that reel steps forward and a light crosses it while the room dims; it closes in at the end. Every reel shows its cover, a play mark and a view count. The Editor pins it on your face, puts the far side behind you and dims the room with it.
origin: MotionLab's own build after a design in Vibha Ramprakash's claude-video-effects (MIT), 2026-10-28
motion: f0-f13 the carousel opens out from behind the person (radius from 25 %, reels from 50 %, decelerating), seen from f0; it spins from f0 and slows to a stop at f88 (1.25 turns, decelerating: fast at first, a horizontal motion smear while a reel moves over 8 px a frame) with reel 1 facing the camera; f88-f96 reel 1 steps forward 7 % (a small overshoot) while the others dim; f92-f108 a band of light crosses it (S-curve); the last 9 f the carousel closes to 70 % and fades (accelerating)

tracks.name: open
tracks.what: the carousel opens out from behind the person

tracks.name: spin
tracks.what: the carousel spins fast and slows to a stop with reel 1 in front

tracks.name: step forward
tracks.what: reel 1 steps forward, the others dim

tracks.name: sheen
tracks.what: a band of light crosses reel 1

tracks.name: close
tracks.what: the carousel closes in and fades

min_frames: start + round((30 + 22 + (10 if leave else 1)) * fps / 30)
min_why: the carousel needs a second to spin down and a moment to show the reel that stopped in front
